name: 29609 · Greenville, SC
findings: ZIP 29609 (Greenville) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29609 (Greenville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29609 (Greenville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
